title: HB2333 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-30; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2908505)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (version dated 2024-01-30); summary says 'As introduced' and no passage vote is recorded, so no amendments are missing.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1302(a)): (8) A switch or auto sear device designed, made, or intended for use in converting a weapon to shoot automatically more than one (1) shot, without manual reloading, by a single function of the trigger; or (9) A firearm built from a weapon parts kit, including a frame or receiver parts kit, and not marked with a serial number.
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1302(d)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1302(d), is amended by deleting "(a)(3) or (a)(4)" and substituting "(a)(3), (a)(4), (a)(8), or (a)(9)".
SECTION 3 (TCA 39-17-1302(f)): (5) An offense under subdivision (a)(8) or (a)(9) is a Class E felony, and in addition to any authorized period of incarceration, shall be punished by a mandatory fine of ten thousand dollars ($10,000).
